Thanks Alice — great to meet you (virtually). I can host and will loop in Karthik (solutions) and Mina (security/infosec) so we have the right specialists. Quick notes up front:

- Our senior EU engineers are on Central European Time (CET, UTC+1 right now). A mid-morning ET session is generally the best overlap for both sides.
- There’s a DST change coming in the US on 8 Mar; it will shift ET from UTC-5 to UTC-4 and can cause follow-up scheduling hiccups. We’ll call that out on the invite so your team isn’t surprised if subsequent meetings move an hour.

Two concrete options that work for the EU engineering group this week:
1) Option A — 09:00–09:45 ET (14:00–14:45 CET) — most hands-on fit for Q&A and live kernel-level discussion
2) Option B — 07:30–08:15 ET (12:30–13:15 CET) — tighter for EU engineers but allows your clinical ops folks earlier in their day

If neither is a hard stop we can also do a later evening ET slot (20:30 ET / 01:30 CET) but that would be late for some EU engineers.

I attached a short runbook (redwood-demo-runbook.xlsx) with modules we plan to cover so you can flag anything to skip/add.

If you confirm Option A, I’ll send a calendar invite with the recording setting on and request Mina join for the SOC2 checklist review.

Cheers,
